transcript.text: bosch 24 not draining, water sitting in bottom. help

Before you start, switch it off and unplug it. I can't confirm what 24 means on your model, so I'll go by what it is doing. From what you have described, the most likely cause is drain filter (twist out and clean - first thing). Take out the lower rack, then twist and lift out the filter in the bottom of the tub. Rinse it under the tap and clear any food, grease or glass from the sump underneath. Was the filter or sump blocked (and is it clean now), or was it already clean?
[Helpful to see: image "Where the filter is" — The filter sits in the base of the dishwasher, usually under the bottom spray arm. Twist it out anticlockwise and rinse it under a tap. Typical layout — your dishwasher may differ.]
filter was blocked, food and a bit of broken glass. cleaned it, drains fine now and E:24 gone. never cleaned it before
Good news, that has sorted it. If it happens again, start with the same check. Is there anything else I can help with?
